page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 24 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 24 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear division between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by bottom-tier results in single-threaded gzip compression and geekbench single-core tests. However, the 24 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU benchmarks. Memory bandwidth and database operations also perform in the middle tier, with Redis SET operations achieving 16.93 million operations per second.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource profile, the ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage all 24 cores, offsetting the lower single-core efficiency. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations, but is less optimal for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring high-speed local storage.
